title: Elements
text:
There are 5 main elements of Qi in the world, which a Qi Source can produce if surrounded by enough blocks of the corresponding element.


These elements suppress each other in the following order:
§cFire§r > §2Wood§r > §aWind§r > §6Earth§r > §9Water§r > §cFire§r


Additionally, each element has various mutations that Qi Sources have a very rare chance to instead produce
